The structure of Mn₃Zr crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a cell formula of Mn₆Zr₂ and eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies 12-coordinate Mn centers with close-packed-like local arrangements (Mn–Mn distances 2.64–2.80 Å) and 10-coordinate Zr centers (Mn–Zr distances 2.66–2.84 Å). The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mn 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Mn 12-vertex and Zr 10-vertex polyhedra.
